chapter.heading: Isaiah 29
The Siege of Jerusalem
chapter.v: let the feasts run their round.
and she shall be to me like an Ariel.
and I will raise siegeworks against you.
and from the dust your speech shall whisper.
And in an instant, suddenly,
with whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of a devouring fire.
like a dream, a vision of the night.
that fight against Mount Zion.
stagger, but not with strong drink!
and covered your heads (the seers).
sealed. When men give it to one who can read, saying, “Read this,” he says, “I cannot, for it is sealed.”
And when they give the book to one who cannot read, saying, “Read this,” he says, “I cannot read.”
and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men,
and the discernment of their discerning men shall be hidden.”
and who say, “Who sees us? Who knows us?”
“He has no understanding”?
and the fruitful field shall be regarded as a forest?
the eyes of the blind shall see.
and the poor among mankind shall exult in the Holy One of Israel.
and all who watch to do evil shall be cut off,
turn aside him who is in the right.
no more shall his face grow pale.
and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
and those who murmur will accept instruction.”

footnotes.footnote: 29:2 *Ariel* could mean *lion of God*, or *hero* (2 Samuel 23:20), or *altar hearth* (Ezekiel 43:15–16)
